name: Quarkdown
description: Quarkdown is a Markdown-based typesetting system that extends CommonMark with functions and compiles to HTML websites, paged documents, slides and PDF.
notes: License GPL-3.0 (GitHub SPDX). firstRelease is the oldest GitHub release, v1.0.0 (2025-05-13). Posts are compiled as subdocuments of one project in a single JVM process. The release zip is x64 only; the image reuses its platform-independent jars on the distro JRE so arm64 works.
